requirements.requirement: Annual independent bias audit by an independent auditor covering impact ratios by sex and race/ethnicity
requirements.platform_feature: Four-fifths disparate impact audit (Gender, AgeBand, Department); race/ethnicity requires customer-supplied data
requirements.gap: Race/ethnicity dimension not in default dataset; independent auditor must be contracted by the deploying organization

requirements.requirement: Post bias audit summary (selection rates, impact ratios) at least 10 days before use
requirements.platform_feature: Bias Audit CSV export downloadable by admin/hrbp
requirements.gap: Public posting on employer website is customer responsibility

requirements.requirement: Notify candidates/employees at least 10 business days before AEDT is applied
requirements.platform_feature: None — notification process is HR's obligation

requirements.requirement: Provide notice of data types and characteristics used by the tool
requirements.platform_feature: Score explanation endpoint lists all features with contribution weights

requirements.requirement: Establish and maintain a risk management system throughout the lifecycle
requirements.platform_feature: MODEL_CARD.md documents limitations, known risks, and out-of-scope use; fairness sign-off gate
requirements.gap: Deployer must document residual risks and maintain the risk management file

requirements.requirement: Training data relevant, representative, free of errors; bias examined
requirements.platform_feature: Data quality report, provenance badge, protected attributes excluded from features, fairness audit

requirements.requirement: Comprehensive technical documentation before placing on market
Automatic logging of system activity sufficient for post-hoc reconstruction
requirements.platform_feature: Immutable AuditLog; records action, entity, user, workspace, timestamp

requirements.requirement: Clear information to deployer including purpose, performance, limitations
requirements.platform_feature: MODEL_CARD.md, score explanation waterfall, validation metrics with bootstrap CI

requirements.requirement: Humans can understand, disregard, and stop the system
requirements.platform_feature: System only produces risk tiers for HR review; no automated decisions; rollback available
requirements.gap: Designating competent oversight persons is deployer responsibility

requirements.requirement: Appropriate accuracy; resilience against errors; cybersecurity
requirements.platform_feature: C-index with bootstrap 95% CI, Brier score, ROC-AUC, temporal backtest; JWT, RBAC, security headers
requirements.gap: Adversarial robustness testing not yet performed

requirements.requirement: Lawfulness, purpose limitation, data minimisation, accuracy, storage limitation, integrity
requirements.platform_feature: Configurable retention policy, data quality report, multi-tenant isolation
requirements.gap: Lawful basis must be established and documented by the deploying organization

requirements.requirement: Data subject access request (DSAR) within 30 days
requirements.platform_feature: Automated DSAR export covering all stored analytical records for the employee

requirements.requirement: Erase personal data on request without undue delay
requirements.platform_feature: Data retention purge removes records older than threshold; per-employee erasure planned for v3.3
requirements.gap: Individual record erasure endpoint not yet implemented

requirements.requirement: No solely automated decisions with significant legal effect; provide logic explanation
requirements.platform_feature: No automated decisions by design; score explanation with waterfall + counterfactual
DPIA_TEMPLATE.md contains a RoPA template; audit log provides partial records
requirements.gap: DPO must complete and sign the RoPA; platform provides template only

requirements.requirement: Data Protection Impact Assessment required for large-scale systematic employee monitoring
requirements.platform_feature: Pre-filled DPIA template included in docs/DPIA_TEMPLATE.md
requirements.gap: DPO must complete, review, and sign the DPIA before going live with real data
